points.description: Identifies the mosquito landing on Sam's arm (i.e. Sam feeling or seeing the mosquito on his arm) as the stimulus.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming the mosquito on Sam's arm (feeling or seeing it) as the stimulus. Equivalent wording earns the mark. No marks for naming the soda, Jasmine jumping up, or Sam's slap, since these are not the stimulus for Sam.
